_note: PLACEHOLDER numbers. THE DESIGN RULE (resources-skills-spec.md §2): every skill answers a specific kind of creature. If it is good against everything it is just a bigger attack. 'answers' names the problem it solves and is printed in the skill list, so the rule is visible to the player rather than only to us. Limiter is a round-counted COOLDOWN per skill and nothing else — no mana pool, deliberately: a second resource to track in every fight is the wrong overhead for this game, so stronger skills carry longer cooldowns instead. 'owner' ties a skill to a party member; when the party expands past two this moves onto the character. Fall Back swaps ranks without spending the turn — it was the one skill held back until ranks existed, and they do now.

skills.name: Unbind
skills.blurb: Pull at the seam holding a thing together.
skills.answers: Anything. The one that always works.

skills.name: Pry
skills.blurb: Find the gap and lever it open.
skills.answers: Heavily plated things, whose armour eats an honest swing.

skills.name: Overbear
skills.blurb: Everything you have, and you're out of position after.
skills.answers: Armoured and slow. You'll act last next round.

skills.name: Sight
skills.blurb: Look at it properly.
skills.answers: Anything you haven't met. Tells you what it's wearing.

skills.name: Draw Off
skills.blurb: Make yourself the obvious problem.
skills.answers: Protecting Quill from something that would finish them.

skills.name: Quicken
skills.blurb: Twice now, nothing next.
skills.answers: Finishing something before it finishes you.

skills.name: Rout
skills.blurb: Leave, and the world doesn't notice you going.
skills.answers: The fight you should never have started. Costs no stability.

skills.name: Mend
skills.blurb: Close what's open. Briefly.
skills.answers: Anyone hurt.

skills.name: Flense
skills.blurb: Open it, and keep it open.
skills.answers: Shaggy, thick-pelted things. Useless on plate.

skills.name: Ward
skills.blurb: Set yourself against one kind of harm.
skills.answers: Whatever you just learned is coming. Ask Sight first.

skills.name: Snuff
skills.blurb: Put out whatever it's giving off.
skills.answers: Things that burn, glow or reek — the damage armour can't stop.

skills.name: Steady
skills.blurb: Press until it stops.
skills.answers: A wound that won't close on its own.

skills.name: Read
skills.blurb: Take it in properly. You'll know it again.
skills.answers: Collecting. A bestiary entry without a kill.

skills.name: Fall Back
skills.blurb: Change where you're standing, and still get your turn.
skills.answers: Being caught in the front rank by something you can't trade with.

skills.name: Shatter
skills.blurb: What it was wearing is not what it is wearing now.
skills.answers: Anything plated. Permanently, for this fight.

skills.name: Finish
skills.blurb: It was nearly over.
skills.answers: Something already hurt. Ends it early.

skills.name: First Strike
skills.blurb: Before it has decided anything.
skills.answers: The opening exchange. You go, then it does.

skills.name: Brace
skills.blurb: You take the next one properly.
skills.answers: A round you know is going to hurt.

skills.name: Sidestep
skills.blurb: That one misses.
skills.answers: A single heavy hitter, once.

skills.name: Interpose
skills.blurb: Not them.
skills.answers: A back rank about to lose somebody.

skills.name: Ground
skills.blurb: Receive the next emanation meant for somebody else.
skills.answers: One active emanation event aimed at another party member.

skills.name: Envenom
skills.blurb: Properly coated, for a while.
skills.answers: High-HP foes, and anything armour would blunt.

skills.name: Conceal
skills.blurb: Not there, for a moment.
skills.answers: Being the thing everything is looking at.

skills.name: Ambush
skills.blurb: The fight starts with your turn.
skills.answers: Opening a fight on your terms.

skills.name: Emanation Strike
skills.blurb: Strike through a ward with a searing emanation.
skills.answers: Warded foes, and anything a plain blade bounces off.
